copy.tagline: 快速查询SaaS财务指标定义、公式与基准值
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果在分析SaaS业务时需要快速查阅财务指标定义与基准
copy.tagline_en: Look up SaaS finance metrics, formulas, and benchmarks fast
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need quick access to SaaS finance metric definitions and benchmarks during analysis

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以快速查询 SaaS 财务指标的定义、公式和基准值，并给出决策框架。
howto.when: 当你在分析或讨论 SaaS 业务时，需要快速查找某个指标的公式、基准或决策规则时触发。

say.text: NRR 的公式是什么？好的基准是多少？
say.note: Claude 会返回 NRR 的公式和基准值。

say.text: 帮我查一下 CAC 回收期和 Rule of 40。
say.note: Claude 会给出这两个指标的快速参考。

say.text: 给我一个 SaaS 指标速查表，用于业务评审。
say.note: Claude 会提供常用指标列表。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can quickly look up SaaS finance metric definitions, formulas, and benchmarks, and provide decision frameworks.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need a fast metric definition, formula, or benchmark during analysis or discussion of SaaS business.

say_en.text: What is the formula for NRR and what is a good benchmark?
say_en.note: Claude returns NRR formula and benchmark.

say_en.text: Give me a quick reference for CAC payback and Rule of 40.
say_en.note: Claude provides quick reference for these metrics.

say_en.text: I need a fast SaaS metrics cheat sheet for a business review.
say_en.note: Claude provides a list of common metrics.
